title: Fix What's Wrong, Keep What's Right: Hallucination Repair for LLM-Based Optimization Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2610.12529v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being explored to automate operations research modeling, reduce modeling time and lower the expertise barrier to optimization based decision support. However, this process often introduces inconsistencies between generated artifacts and the original problem, which we refer to as optimization modeling hallucinations. Despite progress in general-purpose hallucination mitigation, optimization modeling poses a distinct repair challenge: restoring fidelity to the original problem through coordinated model-code updates. We introduce OPT-Kraken, a training-free hallucination repair framework. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first post-hoc framework for repairing hallucinations in LLM-based optimization modeling artifacts. translated_title: 修正错误，保留正确：基于大语言模型的优化建模幻觉修复
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正被越来越多地用于自动化运筹学建模，以缩短建模时间并降低基于优化的决策支持所需的专业门槛。然而，这一过程常常引入生成产物与原始问题之间的不一致性，我们将其称为“优化建模幻觉”。尽管通用的幻觉缓解技术已取得进展，但优化建模带来了独特的修复挑战：需要通过协调的模型与代码更新来恢复对原始问题的忠实性。我们提出了OPT-Kraken，一个无需训练的幻觉修复框架。据我们所知，这是首个针对基于LLM的优化建模产物进行幻觉修复的事后修复框架。它提取问题需求与实例数据，通过检查问题-模型忠实性、模型-代码一致性以及数据基础来定位错误，并选择修复粒度……
tldr: 本文提出OPT-Kraken，首个无需训练的事后幻觉修复框架，通过检查问题-模型忠实性、模型-代码一致性和数据基础三个层面来定位并修复LLM优化建模中产生的幻觉。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces OPT-Kraken, the first training-free post-hoc framework for repairing hallucinations in LLM-based optimization modeling by localizing errors through problem-model fidelity, model-code consistency, and data grounding checks.
